hardInvariants: no broad compatibility claim without physical evidence

transportManifest.docxPayload: public locator payloads and HMAC only
transportManifest.localSecretPolicy: HMAC secret remains local in Yalken and is never embedded in DOCX
transportManifest.tamperPolicy: invalid or missing HMAC is BLOCKED before semantic apply authority

locatorSignals.signal: signed scene and block locator plus baseline guards

modernCommentPackageSemantics.equivalentModernPartsPolicy: unknown comment identity or people parts are BLOCKED or OpaqueUnsupported until semantic readback proves their role
commentPassRequires: semantic readback of body and anchor
reply graph readback where Word permits
resolved or reopened state readback where Word permits
modernCommentPackageSemantics.emptyNoOpSavePolicy: a Word-saved DOCX with no comments parts is failed automation evidence, never modern comment support

painMatrix.pain: scene or paragraph locator lost after Word save
painMatrix.solution: signed multi-signal locator with required HMAC sceneRevision rawSha and unique supported placement
painMatrix.exactPolicy: EXACT requires valid signed locator and unchanged required baseline

painMatrix.pain: repeated text routes to the wrong location
painMatrix.solution: global text search has no authority; fingerprint is manual suggestion only
painMatrix.exactPolicy: ambiguous duplicate placement is MANUAL or BLOCKED

painMatrix.pain: paragraph split or merge breaks offsets
painMatrix.solution: token stream carries paragraph-break revisions and split or merge as explicit structure changes
painMatrix.exactPolicy: only proven single-scene non-overlapping paragraph break changes can become EXACT

painMatrix.pain: Track Changes has more topology than w:ins and w:del
painMatrix.solution: namespace-aware parser covers w:ins w:del w:delText paragraph mark deletes rPrChange pPrChange numbering and move ranges
painMatrix.exactPolicy: moveFrom and moveTo are structural and never automatic in B00

painMatrix.pain: replacement appears as adjacent delete and insert
painMatrix.solution: preserve source events and derive an atomic replacement group with provenance
painMatrix.exactPolicy: replacement group applies or rejects atomically only after all guards pass

painMatrix.pain: modern comments span comments people and extended identity parts
painMatrix.solution: package relationship aware comment graph resolver with unknown modern parts blocked until understood
painMatrix.exactPolicy: comments never grant manuscript apply authority

painMatrix.pain: replies and resolved state are lost
painMatrix.solution: durable thread graph captures parent reply done resolved and reopened state separately from text
painMatrix.exactPolicy: loss of reply or resolve state blocks comment certification

painMatrix.pain: comment on deleted text can disappear after save
painMatrix.solution: extract comments before text classification and preserve quoted anchor related revision and orphan outcome
painMatrix.exactPolicy: orphaned thread is preserved as ORPHAN and never silently deleted

painMatrix.pain: comments are mixed with text apply authority
painMatrix.solution: comment lane stays independent from manuscript lane
painMatrix.exactPolicy: CLEAN MIXED MANUAL or BLOCKED text cannot erase safe comment read authority

painMatrix.pain: author and dates mutate across editors
painMatrix.solution: preserve native author person initials and date separately from normalized local identity
painMatrix.exactPolicy: Yalken never rewrites foreign author truth to manufacture support

painMatrix.pain: formatting gets flattened
painMatrix.solution: whitelist semantic marks and report unsupported direct style or property deltas as typed diagnostics
painMatrix.exactPolicy: unsupported formatting is MANUAL or typed loss report, not destructive apply

painMatrix.pain: structural moves or cross-scene edits masquerade as text
painMatrix.solution: move section table and cross-scene topology routes to structural proposal lane
painMatrix.exactPolicy: cross-scene move and move revisions are not EXACT

painMatrix.pain: Word rewrites rsid ids zip flags and part order
painMatrix.solution: semantic package comparison validates relationships content types and required parts rather than byte equality
painMatrix.exactPolicy: byte drift alone does not prove content mutation

painMatrix.pain: stale or divergent editor copies race
painMatrix.solution: roundId baseline hash effectKey requestKey and branch-of-round detection
painMatrix.exactPolicy: divergent rounds are separate sessions and never auto-merged

painMatrix.pain: repeat import applies twice
painMatrix.solution: write-once outcome ledger with idempotent replay and recovery reconciliation
painMatrix.exactPolicy: replay is ALREADY_ANALYZED or ALREADY_APPLIED, never second mutation

painMatrix.pain: Unicode and locale break boundaries
painMatrix.solution: raw UTF-8 evidence plus NFC comparison view without automatic user text normalization
painMatrix.exactPolicy: NBSP soft hyphen ZWJ ZWNJ ZWSP combining bidi emoji and variation selectors must not be silently rewritten

painMatrix.pain: large manuscripts slow or crash
painMatrix.solution: stream package parts bounded memory per-scene lazy IR limits and hostile-file gates
painMatrix.exactPolicy: scale PASS requires measured thresholds, not invented claims

painMatrix.pain: hostile DOCX or external effects reach runtime
painMatrix.solution: reject macros OLE active content external relationships path traversal zip bombs and network or shell effects
painMatrix.exactPolicy: hostile or malformed packages are BLOCKED

painMatrix.pain: Word Compare and Combine create different revision topology
painMatrix.solution: separate native corpus and semantic equivalence checks
painMatrix.exactPolicy: compare/combine topology is not treated as ordinary hand-edit evidence

painMatrix.pain: footnotes endnotes fields breaks and tables are complex boundaries
painMatrix.solution: inventory and preserve; automatic apply only for explicitly supported subtypes
painMatrix.exactPolicy: unsupported structures receive typed MANUAL or BLOCKED diagnostics with original DOCX evidence preserved
